definitions.explanation: The ratio of output to input, or the effectiveness of achieving results with minimal wasted effort or resources.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{能率|のうりつ}を{上|あ}げる{方法|ほうほう}を{考|かんが}えている。
examples.english: I'm thinking of ways to increase work efficiency.

examples.japanese: このシステムは{能率|のうりつ}が{良|い}い。
{能率|のうりつ}{的|てき}に{働|はたら}くことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。

notes:
USAGE: {能率|のうりつ} focuses on productivity and effectiveness, especially in work contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {能率|のうりつ}が{良|い}い/{悪|わる}い (efficient/inefficient)
- {能率|のうりつ}を{上|あ}げる (to increase efficiency)
- {能率|のうりつ}が{上|あ}がる (efficiency increases)
- {能率|のうりつ}{的|てき}に (efficiently)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {能率|のうりつ}{向上|こうじょう} (efficiency improvement)
- {作業|さぎょう}{能率|のうりつ} (work efficiency)
- {生産|せいさん}{能率|のうりつ} (production efficiency)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {効率|こうりつ} - efficiency (more technical, mathematical)
- {生産性|せいさんせい} - productivity
